items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: I got, I knew George Wettling very well.

ctx.x: The old man Whiteman, Pops, he was such a good friend of my... Of... Of... Of him was, he wouldn't take me away from him. So that was the end of my... I got, I knew George Wettling very well. And... That was it. So I stayed with, I stayed with Dick.
Did you ever record on xylophone? Uh... Background music, just background things. There's a xylophone player with Prima. Yeah.
